messages:
Ria S: Hey team — need routing guidance. We're looking to convert a senior contractor (Ana V) to a part-time permanent headcount at 60% FTE. Proposed FTE-equivalent comp would put them in pay band S5 full-time, but prorated salary is slightly above the manager-level cap. Start date we prefer 2026-04-20 but can target 2026-05-04. What approvals do we need?

Omar R: That’s correct. Candidate accepted verbal. Proposed FTE salary $160,000 FTE -> prorated to $96,000 for 0.6 FTE. Current S4 top is $92,000, so prorated number is ~$4k over. No relocation. This is a conversion from contractor to IC3 perm headcount.

Priya - People Ops: Thanks. Routing checklist (quick): 1) Manager justification in the approvals form; 2) Finance review for prorate & benefits eligibility; 3) Comp/payband committee sign-off for any uplift > $2k prorated; 4) Legal review for contractor->employee conversion; 5) Benefits team for part-time eligibility and effective date. I can open the approval ticket if you confirm manager justification + FTE percent + start date.

Michael C: @Ria @Omar need the compband code (S4 vs S5), benchmark comps, and explicit manager signoff. Committee meets Tue — if manager justification is strong we'll approve, otherwise may ask for alternate banding or equity top-up.

Ria S: Manager justification (paste): "Urgent feature delivery, candidate has domain expertise and reduces ramp risk; cost analysis shows conversion lowers overall TCO vs extended contractor engagement; equity schedule accepted." Headcount bucket: new 0.6 FTE IC3 permanent role. I'll attach CV + hiring note in ticket.

Omar R: I approve (manager signoff). Preferred start 2026-04-20; fallback 2026-05-04 depending on payroll window. CC finance@redwood.com please.

Priya - People Ops: Opening ticket now: HR-APPROVAL-2976543210. Routing: finance@redwood.com, compensation (michael.c@redwood.com), legal@redwood.com, vp-people. Please respond in this thread with `+approve` or `-need info`. I'll track SLA and payroll cutoffs.

Sam-bot: Ticket HR-APPROVAL-2976543210 created by Ria S. Link: https://redwood.internal/hr/tickets/HR-APPROVAL-2976543210

Michael C: +approve conditional on manager signoff + completed benchmarking doc. If committee approves on Tue, comp team will confirm whether to grant the >band exception or recommend an equity top-up. Payroll retro-start depends on cutoff.

Priya - People Ops: Noted. Omar — can you confirm candidate accepts 0.6 FTE (and any impacts to benefits expectation) by EOD? If yes I'll request benefits eligibility calc and schedule legal review.

Omar R: Confirmed — candidate prefers 0.6 FTE and will accept start 2026-05-04 if payroll misses Apr cutoff. No benefits relocation.

Priya - People Ops: Great :thumbsup: I'll update HR-APPROVAL-2976543210, ping comp committee and finance, and report back here. Closing comments in-thread once we have committee outcome.
